Stern Way

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Stern_Way

Stone giants developed the Stern Way, a philosophy and martial art. They will teach it to others. It focuses on throws and blocks.

Connections

*The Enigma, an enormous stone that resembles a bald head, is a site of pilgrimage for adherents, but details of it are absent from their teachings (07.08) *Master Memin is a stone giant who teaches the Stern Way in his Sunken Cathedral (13.20). One manoeuvre, the Emerald Priest Lunge, is known only by him. *Monks of the Stern Way disagree with the meaning of the Long Table, saying that it is the tomb of a dead stone giant emperor who once ruled the world (06.03)
